_notes: Model year intelligence database. Charles is the domain expert — all entries here should be validated by him. Format: make+model key is UPPERCASE. Generations define body/platform boundaries that affect buyer pool and desirability. Known issues affect specific year ranges and have a value_impact_pct (negative = devaluing). Add entries freely — the engine silently ignores anything it doesn't find here.

generations.name: XA50
generations.notes: Complete redesign, much more desirable than XA40. Higher demand, commands significant premium over prior gen.

generations.name: XA40
generations.notes: Older boxy design, significantly less desirable than XA50 despite similar mechanicals.

generations.name: E210
generations.notes: New platform, much more stylish, significantly more desirable.

generations.name: XV70
generations.notes: Major style overhaul, Toyota New Global Architecture, significantly more desirable.

generations.name: T33
generations.notes: New generation, improved reliability, clean break from CVT issues.

known_issues.detail: Jatco CVT7 units prone to failure in cold weather — extremely common in Alberta. High repair cost ($3,000–$5,000). Buyers aware of this; these years trade significantly below 2017+.
All T32 Rogues have CVT concerns; 2017+ are better but not immune. Buyers discount these vs. 2021+ significantly.

generations.name: L34
generations.notes: AWD option added, VC-Turbo engine, fresh styling.

known_issues.detail: Same CVT concerns as Rogue. Less severe but still a discount factor in AB market.

generations.name: RW
generations.notes: Major style/platform update, very desirable gen.

known_issues.detail: 1.5L turbo in cold climates experiences fuel diluting into oil. Honda issued service bulletin but not full recall. Can cause engine wear. Buyers who know this discount these years.

generations.name: FE/FL
generations.notes: Clean new design, much more desirable than gen 10.

known_issues.detail: Same issue as CR-V — fuel mixing into oil in cold climates. Affects AB market pricing.

generations.name: P702
generations.notes: Aluminum body continued, new hybrid options, major interior refresh. Highly desirable.

generations.name: P415
generations.notes: Aluminum body introduced — initially some buyer skepticism but now fully accepted.

known_issues.detail: High mileage 2011-2014 3.5L EcoBoost engines prone to timing chain issues. Significant repair cost.
Early aluminum-body trucks. Some buyers concerned about repair costs though issue is mostly resolved with shop education.

generations.name: DT
generations.notes: Completely new truck — coil spring rear suspension, much more refined. Strong demand.

generations.name: DS/DJ
generations.notes: "Classic" body continues in production alongside gen 5.

known_issues.detail: ZF 8HP70 transmission calibration issues. Software fix available but not always applied. Common complaint.

generations.name: JL
generations.notes: JL is widely preferred over JK — improved refinement, better highway manners, new engines. Commands clear premium.

known_issues.detail: First-year JL had some electrical gremlins and soft-top sealing issues. Minor discount vs 2021+ JL.

generations.name: WL
generations.notes: Completely new platform — 3-row option, premium positioning. Much more desirable than WK2.

known_issues.detail: Common tick/rattle at startup in cold weather. Usually cosmetic but concerning to buyers.

generations.name: NX4
generations.notes: Dramatic redesign — polarizing but widely popular. Commands strong premium.

generations.name: NQ5
generations.notes: New platform, highly styled, strong demand.

generations.name: MQ4
generations.notes: New platform — much more refined, available mild hybrid.

generations.name: CV
generations.notes: New platform, more car-like.

known_issues.detail: Known issue with coolant entering combustion chamber. Ford extended warranty but many were not fixed. Significant discount for high-mileage examples.

generations.name: C1XX
generations.notes: Lighter, more efficient. Cleaner design.

known_issues.detail: Excessive oil consumption known issue. Class action settlement. Very high buyer awareness — heavy discounting on 2010-2012.

generations.name: U625
generations.notes: Rear-wheel-drive platform switch, more premium focus. New buyer perception.

known_issues.detail: NHTSA investigation into exhaust entering cabin through rear door seals. Safety concern. Ford issued fix but buyer awareness is high and discount is real.

generations.name: WD
generations.notes: Long-running generation — no major redesign. Minor facelift updates.

known_issues.detail: See Grand Cherokee — same engine, same concern.
Some examples consume oil at higher-than-normal rates. Well-documented concern in the Subaru community. Buyers discount these.

generations.name: T1
generations.notes: New platform shared with Silverado 1500 T1. Significant improvement.

generations.name: T1XX
generations.notes: New platform — lighter, more tech, strong demand.

known_issues.detail: Torque converter shudder in 8-speed equipped trucks. Fluid fix usually resolves it but buyers are aware.
